comparison.finding_title: South versus North mean cost per parcel

blocks.heading: Scope of this review
paragraphs: This recurring review compares mean handling cost per parcel across the North, South and Pilot lanes for the 2026 Q3 synthetic batch set.
All figures are descriptive. Batches carry equal analytical weight and no causal savings estimate is made.

blocks.heading: Method and limitations
paragraphs: Each batch contributes one integer cost in cents per parcel. A lane enters the comparison only with at least four batches, which is a declared demo policy rather than a significance test.
Lane membership reflects the current effective assignment recorded in the operations graph, which can differ from the lane originally written on the dispatch record.

blocks.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: This memo summarises the recorded cost case for the proposed South lane expansion, for the Operations Review team.

blocks.heading: Other considerations
paragraphs: Capacity, hiring lead time and depot availability were raised in the planning session and are not analysed here.
Nothing in this section has been assessed against the linked evidence.
